entity_id_migration.title: Entity ID migration
entity_id_migration.description:
This integration now suggests entity IDs based on the Tank Utility short device ID (e.g., **{example}**). Home Assistant does not automatically rename existing entity IDs once they are created.

If your entities still use the old prefix (for example, based on the device name), you can:

- Rename them in **Settings → Devices & services → Entities**, or
- Remove the integration and delete the old entities, then add it again to get IDs starting with **{short_id}**.
